block.storagenetwork.collector.guide: 這會公開網路並充當其他自動化系統或存儲解決方案的僅插入控制器。例如，將一個普通漏斗指向網路上的交換界面，它將像$(l:import_kabel)導入電纜$(/l)一樣將物品插入有效的網路插槽中。但是，它不允許提取任何物品。試試使用其他存儲模組！

block.storagenetwork.exchange.tooltip: 將物品網路內的物品從此接口輸出
block.storagenetwork.export_kabel.guide: 當連接上一個儲存裝置後，導出纜線將會從網路取出物品至儲存裝置上。$(br)所有的導出纜線之間都有優先度順序與紅石訊號控制，並接受纜線升級。
block.storagenetwork.export_kabel.toolti: 將來自網路的物品導出到連接的物品欄。
block.storagenetwork.filter_kabel.guide: 每條連接纜線僅會連接一個儲存裝置至網路，具有優先級設置，並與導出纜線共用優先級順序；接受纜線升級。
block.storagenetwork.filter_kabel.toolti: 帶有過濾選項的連接纜線
block.storagenetwork.import_filter_kabel: 過濾導入纜線也會時時的將相連裝置內的物品接入網路。它能在控制介面裏設置纜線升級、物品篩選器，和紅石訊號控制。$(br2)允許清單即意味著只會接受與清單內相符的物品通過，忽略清單會將除吻合清單以外的所有物品通過線纜；導入過濾器會將當下纜線裏的物品匯入清單之中。
帶有過濾選項的導入纜線
block.storagenetwork.import_kabel.guide: 導入纜線會時時的將相連裝置內的物品接入網路。$(br2)升級至$(l:import_filter_kabel)過濾導入電纜$(/l)以使用更多詳細設定。
block.storagenetwork.import_kabel.toolti: 將物品從連接的物品欄導入到網路中。
block.storagenetwork.inventory.guide: 可以完整查看、放入或提出網路的物品。$(br)$(l:inventory_remote)點擊這裡$(/l)來查看遙控器版本的儲存庫存。

block.storagenetwork.kabel.guide: 網路纜線只能與網路方塊相接。
block.storagenetwork.master.guide: 建構網路的核心，每個網路僅能有一個，放置超過一個將會使其他的被破壞，且有可能會導致遙控器或線纜的連接問題。$(br2)將儲存網主機移開網路將會破壞網路、中斷輸入輸出，和遙控器的操作。只要每個網路之間不互相連接，單個世界是允許多個網路存在的。
block.storagenetwork.master.tooltip: 每個網路只能使用一個
block.storagenetwork.request.guide: 可以完整查看、放入或提出網路的物品；並內建一個合成台，可利用網路內的物品進行合成。$(br2)$(l:crafting_remote)點擊這裡$(/l)來查看遙控器版本的儲存合成台。
block.storagenetwork.request.tooltip: 用於總覽和請求網路中的物品。
block.storagenetwork.storage_kabel.guide: 每條連接纜線僅會連接一個儲存裝置至網路，這些纜線是連接儲存裝置到網路的主要連接口，沒有優先級或任何的自動化設置。$(br)若需要這些配置，連接纜線得先升級成$(l:filter_kabel)過濾連接纜線$(/l)。

book.adorablehamsterpets.category.access: 为那些腰缠万贯但仍然感觉少点什么的仓鼠准备。$(br2)本章节引入了一些最新的啮齿潮流，从花朵装饰到...嗯，现在只有这些。但我们会在之后的更新里推出更多小装饰的！
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.advanc: 仓鼠能干的事不只是存在并让人觉得可爱，或者只是吃掉你给的饲料。$(br2)本章节会着重讲述不为人知的秘密。你知道的，就是那些能让你怀疑这是否在方块世界里能真实出现的事。如果你觉得 $(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet) <dark_green><b>投掷</>很怪，那么这就是你需要的。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.announ: 一些新闻、调查以及作者的闲言碎语。比听起来更有意思，我保证。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.crops_: 仓鼠未动，粮草先行。$(br2)本章节讲述了仓鼠的食物链，从搜寻野生种子，再到亲自培育 $(l:crops_food/green_beans)<dark_green><b>充满能量的豆类作物</>。$(br2)还有最重要的，$(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>奶酪</>。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.landin: 你想要小仓鼠，对吧？$(br2)这是个听起来很棒，但又难以预料的目标。$(br2)本宝典包含了观察啮齿动物所得的宝贵智慧。风险自负。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.loot_a: 如果没有锁，那捡到就归谁。$(br2)<i>就算</>被锁上了，用撬棍给他干开。$(br2)这部分讲述了如何找到有关仓鼠的战利品，以及在箱子里和仓鼠嘴里都装着什么。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.should: 给你的小小伙伴喂食 $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>奶酪</>，可以让它们跳上你的肩膀。它们可以充当小小警报器，在<dark_green><b>苦力怕</>靠近时提醒你，或者当附近有<dark_aqua><b>钻石</>时，它们也会发出兴奋的叫声。$(br2)学着在躲避怪物或者下矿时倾听它的叫声吧。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.the_ha: 想要更多的小仓鼠？<i>好极了。</>$(br2)本章节讲述了核心内容——找到野生仓鼠，用美味的诱饵驯服，还有教会它们如何坐下。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.the_ki: 你来到了正确的地方，朋友。$(br2)你可以在这里找到 $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<b>配置菜单</>，以及我们 $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<b>繁荣的仓鼠俱乐部</>，以及<i>易于触及</>的 $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/support_the_mod)<b>捐赠按钮</>。$(br2)四处看看吧。
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.update: 新东西，修好的东西，以及马上要坏掉的东西。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.acorn_hat: 将<dark_green><b>坚果帽</>放入$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>饰品</>栏，让仓鼠变身树栖动物：$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>叶间掠夺</>产出的物品数量增加。$(br2)让它看起来像颗坚果也许能让它注意到先前没发现的橡果。或者只是因为它们穿着好看的衣服会更喜欢干活。
这帽子简直精妙到$(br)“<i>让人疯狂</>”$(br)  还有，“<i>变多</>”。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.aggressio: 有些时候，你的小家伙<i>太</>喜欢防着你，或者不够热情。$(br2)好消息是：它们的胃袋可以轻松控制大脑。你可以用美味的食物永久转变它们的$(br)   敌对状态。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.ahp_comma: 适用于需要违反自然的人。$(br2)通过命令 <b>/ahb spawn hamster</> 生成任意毛色的仓鼠。$(br2)命令会自动补全，这样就不必手动拼凑出所有 {TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS} 种仓鼠。
不小心在你的卧室里召唤了一大团仓鼠？$(br2)这个命令可以让上一次命令中生成的仓鼠全部消失。
强制基因引擎重新计算，并将其当前三维空间与包含的毛色计算发送到<b>日志</>或<b>聊天栏</>。$(br2)非常适合调试$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置文件</>改动后的结果，便于更快速地查看仓鼠类型而$(br)   无需手动繁殖。
穿越时空。按年、月或日调整仓鼠的年龄。附带命令自动补全。$(br2)如果你刚升级到 v3.6.0，旧仓鼠的年纪会显示成<i>0 天</>。如果没有看向附近的仓鼠使用这条命令，那么会自动选择离你最近的仓鼠。
<b>/reset_player</>$(br2)清理你的仓鼠繁殖记录。$(br2)如果服务器启用了繁殖限制，且你已经达到了$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置</>中的上限，那么你可以使用这个命令重置。
<b>/reset_hamster</>$(br2)仓鼠有一个$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>可自由配置</> 的繁殖数量上限。$(br2)这会将附近仓鼠的繁殖上限调回零，便于再次进行繁殖。
中和本地生物群系。$(br2)所有树木会立刻失去$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>你用仓鼠掏空它们</>的记忆，并准备再次馈赠。$(br2)生养我们的大地竟然如此心胸宽广。
如下的两条命令会按组显示野生仓鼠的毛色搭配。$(br2)默认情况下，它们会生成所有 {BASE_PALETTES} 种基础颜色。命令末尾加上 <b>true</> 可以浏览体色与$(l:the_hamster_life/regional_rodents#wild_possibilities)<dark_green><b>野生毛色</>的组合。同时你也可以在命令末尾加上作者的名字来寻找它们。
在此之前你得先了解一下 <dark_green><b>性能模式</>。$(br2)这个模式下，所有纹理与几何都会被去除，把仓鼠变成高效方正的生物。可以在 <b>控制</> 设置中切换自定义热键。
将仓鼠按其数学上的立体颜色区间，系统性地修整为平面网格，便于你在$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>驯服</>时更容易接近它们。$(br2)$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>驯服</>能“叫醒”它们，重新启用它们的 AI。
将仓鼠悬空生成。它们在 3D 空间中的位置分别表示毛色的色调、饱和度与亮度。$(br2)这个由仓鼠构成的圆柱形可以帮你预测一对仓鼠繁育后代的$(br)   毛色。
将<b>野生毛色</>设置为 <b>true</> 可以看到所有 {TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS} 种野生变体。$(br2)设置<b>采样繁殖毛色</> 设置为 <b>true</> 可以看到三种繁殖毛色的样本，一共是 {TOTAL_WILD_PLUS_BREEDING_SAMPLE_VARIANTS} 种变体。
设置 <b>匹配玩家视角</> 使得它们在拍照时跟你一同转头。$(br2)设置<b>随机坐下</>与/或<b>瞌睡</>为 true 可以让它们展现出更多动作。
手持这本宝典时，在立体界面右键点击两只仓鼠可以查看它们的后代。$(br2)管理员可以用箭头调整基因多样性及突变率。改动会立即保存到配置并应用，$(br)   且全服有效。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.basic_car: 它们会跟着。$(br2)一直跟着。$(br2)右键点击驯服仓鼠可以让它<b>坐下</>。$(br2)有时坐着坐着就会瞌睡。再次<b>右键点击</>它们就可以重新跟随你。
$(br)希望小仓鼠能坐下休息？$(br2)试着合成一个$(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bed)<dark_green><b>仓鼠窝</>吧。$(br2)这个仓鼠窝有着奇妙的奶酪香味，由绝对天然环保的有机落叶组成——没有仓鼠不会喜欢这些的。有了一个窝之后，仓鼠就会在附近转悠而不是一直跟着你。你人真好。
野生仓鼠需要和严酷的自然环境斗争，但驯服后的仓鼠可以吃软饭。$(br2)它们的后代可以继承<b>父母的毛色</>，组合成野生仓鼠没有的新样式。
仓鼠的父母会将它们的体色传给后代。$(br2)父母颜色越接近 = 后代颜色越相像。反之 = 越不相像。$(br2)组合 <u>{TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS}</> 种野生仓鼠，探索繁殖出所有 <u>{TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS}</> 种不同的样子。
部分颜色偏淡的野生仓鼠有可能会长着一双红眼睛。你同样可以通过繁殖得到红眼仓鼠。$(br2)别盯着看它，或者随你的便，我又不给你干活。
幼崽自打出生便有良好家教，把你当做陌生人（除非你在配置里$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>关闭</>）。$(br2)$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<dark_green><b>驯服</>它们可以快速认亲。$(br2)如果想分给朋友小仓鼠，你就可以让他们喂仓鼠。
喂仓鼠可以加快它们的生长。小时候的它们还不是很$(l:the_hamster_life/feeding#pickiness)<dark_green><b>挑食</>。$(br2)注意：驯服后，成年之前它们仍然会跟随父母。可以用 $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>{LURE_ITEM}</> 把它们拐走。
如果在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置</>里开启，你的仓鼠会有繁殖上限，会拒绝你的要求。$(br2)如果你有管理员权限，你可以自由调整繁殖上限，或者通过$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands#reset_player_breeding)<dark_green><b>命令</>重置限制。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.cheek_pou: 藏在嘴里的...物品栏。喂给它们一些东西才能找到这里。之后，对着驯服的仓鼠<b>蹲下+右键点击</>，可以打开六个格子的界面。$(br2)受伤时，它们会自动吃掉嘴里的 $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix) <dark_green><b>混合鼠粮</>。

$(br)以及，别想着把下界合金块给塞进它们的嘴里。仓鼠的脸颊虽然容得下美食，但不能当做口袋维度使用。它们不会含着任何体积太大、尖锐或是纯粹不合逻辑的东西。
$(br2)如果你想要让仓鼠表演吞剑或者含住其他方块，可以打开<b>配置文件</>自行调整。

<dark_green><b>饰品</>与<dark_green><b>盔甲</>栏提供了手动控制$(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>饰品</>和$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor)<dark_green><b>盔甲</>的能力。$(br2)严格来讲，你能<b>右键</><i>直接</>给仓鼠穿戴饰品或装备，或者用<b>剪刀</>去掉它们，因此这两个格子没有什么用。
$(br)不过我还是把它们加进来了。$(br2)没关系，我应该的。$(br2)总之，像你们这样的城里人<i>可能更</>喜欢在界面里优雅操作，而不是直接粗暴的点击交互。$(br2)看的就是你，张三。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.cheese.pa: 这不仅是小小啮齿动物难以抗拒的美味，你也可以来上一口。$(br2)它的营养出奇地丰富，会顺着你的喉咙滑下，吃得比其他食物快许多，但也会发出奇怪的...<i>湿润的咀嚼声</>。
是的，就像魔法一样，从一桶牛奶再到几片美味的多孔奶酪。这就是科学，别多问。$(br2)（翻下页）

$(br)不过，之后有可能翻新奶酪的制作过程。
$(br2)加入 Discord 帮忙决定它们的未来吧！
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.config_he: 不期待仓鼠敞开它的腮帮？希望这些提示消失？对那些管理员说：这模组高度可配置。可以按需修改。$(br2)或者搞砸一切。随你的便。
$(br)出于方便目的，我在这里设置了一个按钮，你可以用它直接打开模组的配置界面。$(br2)你不知道这是什么？准备好大吃一惊吧。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.creeper_p: 惊慌失措的叫声？这可能是<b>苦力怕</>跟上了你。不一定是附近，只是<red><b><i>“盯上”</>了你。$(br2)也许，你的仓鼠在担心你会被崩飞。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.crop_harv: 挖矿的时候应该没人会偷你的庄稼，确实是这样。$(br2)如果仓鼠窝靠近耕地而且它在闲逛，它可能会对你的农作物进行<i>质检</>并把它们塞进$(br)   自己的嘴里。

$(br)仓鼠非常潦草，可能会把种子撒在地里，这样你的庄稼至少还能多长一阵子。$(br2)你也可以挖开它们的 $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>脸颊</> 拿回你被偷取的作物。$(br2)可以在 $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置</> 中自定义作物、时间以及其他设置。
在温暖的生物群系中找到这些<dark_green><b>野黄瓜丛</>。$(br2)右键点击摘取。$(br2)这是你打开仓鼠乐园大门的第一步。
种下种子。$(br2)等等，再等等。$(br2)摘下<dark_green><b>黄瓜</>。等的时候别嘴馋。$(br2)就像原版的小麦一样，收获时会获得更多的种子。
将黄瓜放入合成台，获得<dark_green><b>切片黄瓜</>。$(br2)这就是$(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<b>驯服</>野生仓鼠的诱饵，也可以用来$(l:the_hamster_life/feeding)<b>治疗</>它们。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.custom_ac: 现在的装饰数量...极其有限。但仓鼠杂货铺才刚刚开张呢！$(br2)我有很多饰品的想法，因为网友们真的是点子王。$(br2)开动你的小脑袋瓜，帮我们想想
下一个<i>值得入手</>的饰品吧！$(br2)点击下面的按钮加入我们的官方 Discord 服务器：$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch</>。$(br2)来的时候带上你的小动物！（我可太爱看了，绝对不嫌多！）
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.feeding.p: 如果你的仓鼠有什么不高兴的，或者只是无聊了，你都可以喂些东西给它。$(br2)当情况紧急时，你可以制作$(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>混合鼠粮</>喂给它。它不会拒绝的。
如果仓鼠很健康，基础的食物可能会让它进入...<b>求爱模式</>。$(br2)找到同样处于求爱模式的另一只仓鼠。$(br2)退后，顺其自然。
不要重复喂它同样的食物。它会吃腻。$(br2)除了这些东西：$(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>混合鼠粮</> （美食）以及 $(l:crops_food/green_beans#item)<dark_green><b>蒸青豆</>。
这些 $(l:crops_food/green_beans#item)<dark_green><b>蒸青豆</>？这只是些熟青豆罢了。它们可以给仓鼠提供短暂的速度、力量、伤害吸收以及生命再生。酷！$(br2)...但是这些效果也有冷却期。这不太酷。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.flowers.p: 代码会自动扫描带有关键词的花朵名称（<i>blue</>, <i>dark</>, <i>crimson</>, <i>magic</> 等），基于此分配 <b>12 种纹理</>。如果某个模组添加了<b>蓝色</>的<i>魔法玫瑰</>，那么仓鼠身上可能会显示<b>红色花瓣</>，$(br)   因为它被检测到的关键词是<i>玫瑰</>。
$(br)若出现这种情况，你可以通过<b>数据包</>自动覆写扫描数据。$(br2)有关教程请浏览$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch</> Discord 聊天群组的 <b>FAQ</> 频道，搜索 <i>'Custom Flower Accessories'</>。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.green_bea: 在气候温和潮湿的地方可以找到 <dark_green><b>野青豆丛</>。右键点击获得种子。$(br2)这些东西可不只是装饰菜地的。
种下种子，等待奇迹发生，然后就可以得到 <dark_green><b>青豆</>。$(br2)非常简单。
将青豆丢进熔炉，可以获得 <dark_green><b>蒸青豆</>。$(br2)可以用于$(l:the_hamster_life/feeding)<dark_green><b>治疗</>仓鼠，以及——最重要的是——酷炫的$(l:the_hamster_life/feeding#buffs)<dark_green><b>兴奋仓鼠</>。
是的，你闻闻它。这多棒啊。$(br2)未来会产生更...有趣的制作方法，也许引入多方块结构...还有水桶？拭目以待吧。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_b: 窝&闲逛模式

“跟着你去岩浆游泳”听起来不像是什么好事。$(br2)合成 $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bedding)<dark_green><b>仓鼠窝垫</> 并将其与木板结合，可以设置一个优质的聚会点，当仓鼠处于 $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#wander_mode)<dark_green><b>驯服后的闲逛模式</> 时，它们就会以这个地方为中心闲逛。
你得自己发现剩下的四个配方。$(br2)你很聪明，应该能自己找到这些。$(br2)另附：不要把窝翻过来放下。<i>嘿嘿。</>
放下仓鼠窝之后<i>（别真的倒着放）</>，你现在就拥有了一个小小的落叶指挥中心：$(br2)• <b>右键点击</> 切换闲逛模式。$(br2)• <b>$(k:sneak) + 右键点击</> 切换闲逛距离。
驯服后闲逛模式
$(br)• 用 $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>奶酪</> 可以把仓鼠引到窝里。$(br2)• 用<b>腐肉</>让窝...散发微妙的味道，避免仓鼠犯困。$(br2)• <b>$(k:sneak) + 腐肉</>可以完全取消与窝的绑定。$(br2)另外，搬走仓鼠窝也可以关掉闲逛模式。$(br2)喔。
如果你或管理员在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置</>中启用了“床中重生”，那么床可以作为仓鼠的重生点。$(br2)当你的仓鼠大限将至，它会在床上醒来，把一切都当成噩梦。
永远不死？
$(br)保留物品栏，但不会保留勇气。可能需要心理干预。$(br2)<b><i>注意</>：如果你正在通过其他模组为宠物添加神奇力量，鉴于我还没有在模组里编写兼容代码，它们可能会丢失。
仓鼠卡在某个地方或不知所踪？没关系。上床睡觉就行了。它们会在晚上利用<i>它们的神功</>溜回家。$(br2)醒来的时候你就会发现它们就在身边，假装没有偷偷调用传送代码。
夜班
仓鼠，但<i>不会</>主动跟着你。
看哪，多难得的景象。
就在这里：$(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bed)<dark_green><b>仓鼠窝</> 的合成配方。$(br2)它也可以卷成彩纸炮吹出去，这可不是我说的啊。
你需要将如下材料混合在一起：$(br)1. 优质落叶。$(br)2.几根树枝。$(br2)你会得到：非常炫酷的手工地铺窝。
找不到哪里有枯死的灌木？$(br2)拿上一把<b>剪刀</>对着任意树苗疯狂修剪。$(br2)嘭！你要的灌木。
植物谋杀
是的是的。这就是仓鼠窝。$(br2)这可以让仓鼠在情感、灵魂与数据层面和它绑定。$(br2)如果选错了仓鼠$(br)也不用着急，一片腐肉就可以解决这个问题。
手持仓鼠窝 <b>右键点击</> 驯服的仓鼠可以绑定。$(br2)现在仓鼠无暇顾及你在哪里，它更想要在窝周围跑来跑去。
放在你的基地门口，或者扮演部落冲突。你的$(br)选择。
坐标颜色！
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_f: 合成这个，或者什么都不做。仓鼠可是你养的。$(br2)总之，它会以某种奇妙的方式治愈仓鼠，还是少数即使重复喂食也不会被它们拒绝的东西。这也是打开它们脸颊$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<b>储物空间</>的钥匙。
$(br)不正确的操作可能导致一系列连锁反应。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_l: 野生仓鼠是智能扫地机器人。它们有一半的概率口含物品生成。$(br2)里面可能有随处可见的$(l:crops_food)<dark_green><b>种子</>、金属颗粒、蔬菜和其他小东西。它们很害羞，所以记得带上点$(br)  $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>好吃的</>。
$(br)不喜欢它们的收纳品味，想让它们的嘴里吐出象牙？$(br2)你现在有这机会改变一切。你可以在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置界面</> 中修改它嘴里生成的物品。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.how_acces: 你的仓鼠会有一个叫“$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>饰品</>”的格子。是的，就是这个词。不不不，我才不要改掉它呢。$(br2)手持饰品<b>右键点击</>仓鼠即可装备。或者，如果你喜欢菜单，你也可以打开它们的$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>界面</>并手动放入。

$(br)除此之外，仓鼠也有独立的“$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>装备</>”栏。它与你想的一样。$(br2)提示：基本的橡果盔甲<i>也</>包含了装饰用的帽子，但如果你需要树栖动物特质，你还是需要在饰品栏里装备$(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>橡果帽</>。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.join_the_: 想到了什么仓鼠饰品的绝妙点子？还是想要给我们看看你的小家伙？或者只是想看看有什么新内容？$(br2)赶快进入官方 Discord 聊天群组：$(br)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch</>。
$(br)我们有点子频道、问题反馈频道、截图分享频道，甚至还可以在现实宠物频道分享你养的小动物。$(br2)来帮忙塑造模组的未来吧！
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.missing_b: 弄丢了这本无价的啮齿智慧宝典，或者只是想再要一本？$(br2)多惊讶啊。$(br2)$(c:/function adorablehamsterpets:player/give_book_to_self)<b>点击这里</>获取，或者也可以用原版的<b>书</>与模组的 $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>切片黄瓜</>在工作台中合成得到。
不要问为什么是黄瓜片。$(br2)这就要谈起一个可悲的仓鼠和不幸的水池事故了。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.musical_r: 有没有想过让飞出的仓鼠击中苦力怕会发生什么？$(br2)我也没有，不过有人试过了。$(br2)现在我听这些洗脑魔音停不下来了...
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.psycholog: 你的仓鼠散发出一种独特的气息，只能被<b>蜘蛛</>和暴怒的<b>灾厄村民</>感知到。$(br2)利用这个特点——看着灾厄村民们
$(br)被这个小不点追着。$(br2)等等...这可能就是灾厄村民那么怕它的原因？$(br2)这需要深入研究。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.regional_: 总而言之，仓鼠会适应环境。不过它们的毛色是原产地决定的。$(br2)有些毛色会比其他类型更...<b><i>容易出现</>。$(br2)繁殖产生的后代有时会有不同的白色花纹。
<i><light_gray>其他 69 种仓鼠不愿配合演出。</>

野生仓鼠的外观由 <u>{BASE_PALETTES}</> 底色与 <u>{WILD_OVERLAYS}</> 花纹叠层组成，一共有 <u>{TOTAL_WILD_VARIANTS}</> 种不同的组合。$(br2)除了洞穴仓鼠以外，大部分仓鼠都有白/奶油黄/灰色底色。$(br2)需要全部浏览一遍？试试看$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands)<dark_green><b>这些命令</>吧。
让一对野生仓鼠$(l:the_hamster_life/breeding)<dark_green><b>繁殖</> ，后代有可能会多出额外花纹，或者改变眼睛颜色。一共有 <u>{TOTAL_POSSIBLE_VARIANTS}</> 种不同的搭配。$(br2)对其中某种仓鼠感兴趣？去看看$(l:the_hamster_life/breeding)<dark_green><b>繁殖</>章节吧。
$(br)<b>感到困难？</>$(br2)安装 Jade 模组，再看看你的仓鼠。$(br2)Jade 的查询提示框会显示它们的基因：体色、花纹、年龄、生命值，以及是否携带红眼基因。
想要浏览所有仓鼠，或者生成用于展示的无 AI 仓鼠吗？$(br2)浏览$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/ahp_commands)<dark_green><b>生成命令</>章节吧。$(br2)静止不动的仓鼠在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置启用</>的情况下也可以通过驯服重获生机。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.subterran: 兴奋的嗅探声？你的口袋探矿仪发现附近有<dark_aqua><b>钻石</>！默认搜寻半径是 10 格。$(br2)它会被警告打断，所以在开始挖之前请再三检查。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.sunflower: 这可不是普通的装饰用太阳花。右键结籽的向日葵可以收获<dark_green><b>葵花籽</>——合成$(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>混合鼠粮</>的关键原料。$(br2)不，你还不能种那个种子。那个功能还在...开发中。还是等等吧。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.support_t: 可爱小仓鼠原本只是为我的妻子设计的周末计划，后来逐渐发展为庞大的项目。我的目标是在周末时为模组添加更多功能，修复漏洞，以及想出更多点子。$(br2)现在只有我一人编写模组代码，你为我捐赠的每一杯咖啡
$(br)都是我“每日”调试仓鼠与代码时的鼓励与支持。$(br2)如果你喜欢这个模组，想要赞助开发，请考虑为我买杯咖啡！感谢你支持我做出更多好玩的内容。              :)
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.taming.pa: 首先，你需要诱饵。$(br2)这好东西来自于$(l:crops_food/cucumber)<dark_green><b>黄瓜</>。$(br2)在温暖的生物群系中找到$(l:crops_food/cucumber#bush)<dark_green><b>野生黄瓜丛</> —— 平原、热带平原，或许还有丛林边缘。$(br2)<b>右键点击</>它们可以获得种子。

在耕地上种下$(l:crops_food/cucumber#crop)<dark_green><b>黄瓜种子</>。成熟后，可以得到$(l:crops_food/cucumber#crop)<dark_green><b>黄瓜</>。$(br2)现在，最重要的一步：将黄瓜变成$(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>切片黄瓜</>。这就是小毛球最想要的美食。
$(br)是的，真正的驯服。$(br2)记住：<b>蹲下</>（<b>$(k:sneak)</>）。$(br2)手持 $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>黄瓜片</>。$(br2)缓缓靠近。希望它不会注意到你突然出现。$(br2)重复尝试，直到你成功驯服它们。
$(br)<b>还是不正常？</>$(br2)其他模组可能导致了驯服无法顺利进行。如果你碰到了问题，请在 $(l:https://discord.gg/w54mk5bqdf)<dark_green><b>'The Cheek Pouch'</> Discord 聊天群组中的 FAQ 频道浏览相关信息。读完之前请勿随意提问。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.the_hamst: 言语难以描述的仓鼠飞弹。瞄准（不要直接对着方块），再按下 <b>$(k:adorablehamsterpets.throw_hamster)</>。$(br2)它造成的伤害正好可以一击杀死苦力怕。扔出去的仓鼠会趴在地上。快去把它捡起来。
$(br)按下 <b>$(k:adorablehamsterpets.throw_hamster)</> 以后没有扔出你的仓鼠吗？$(br2)你是否中途将这个模组添加进世界的？哎呀。$(br2)前往：<b>选项 > 控制 > 按键绑定</>。找到<gold><b>“投掷仓鼠”</>，将其设置为 <b>G</>（或你喜欢的其他键）。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tiny_pros: 坐在肩膀上的小家伙是不是刚刚提醒你附近有$(l:advanced_rodentry/subterranean_shinies)<dark_aqua><b>钻石</>？太棒了。$(br2)最有意思的部分来了。将你的小家伙放下。如果它打算去找宝藏的话，它就会开始动起来。
$(br)看着它尝试接近你梦寐以求的宝藏。$(br2)但是小心：在仓鼠的眼里，钻石长得和金子差不多...所以它可能会找错。
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tree_heis: 树木劫掠&盔甲
若要获得仓鼠盔甲，首先要将你的仓鼠$(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>扔进</> 橡树叶（或者在站在上面放下仓鼠）才能开始<dark_green><b>搜刮树叶</>。$(br2)它们会钻进树叶里，四处走动，然后最终叼着<dark_green><b>橡果</>出现在树下，直到树被薅秃。
<light_gray><i>我和小仓鼠$(br)  在备战</>
树记得一切。重复掠夺一棵树会导致它被薅秃。$(br2)需要大约一天时间才能重新获得自然馈赠。$(br2)等不及？在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置界面</>里有“清除历史”功能。
橡果经济
觉得大自然太抠搜？我在$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>配置界面</>里给你添加了一个新的功能。$(br2)调高“橡果掉落几率”可以享受橡果雨（限制：每秒至多掉落一颗）。$(br2)当然背包爆满的时候可别来怪我。
市场操纵

那些亮亮的<dark_green><b>橡果</>？它们本身没什么用，除非你喜欢玩异食游戏。$(br2)将它们塞进<b>切石机</>获得$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>橡果碎壳</>，用来合成$(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>装备</>或者漂亮的$(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>橡果帽</>。
战利品
将帽子与橡果结合，合成<dark_green><b>橡果盔甲</>。$(br2)吸收所有伤害，直到它彻底损坏。
硬菜沙拉
就像狼铠$(br)  ，但是更加$(br)  可爱。
坚果做的盔甲看上去就很豪华。如果用的是魔法坚果那就更棒了。$(br2)扔进附魔台可以为其附上<b>耐久</>与<b>火焰保护</>附魔。$(br2)第二种附魔可以防止仓鼠实践在岩浆游泳的想法时把自己烤熟。
魔力啮齿动物
附魔书与铁砧可以为盔甲增加<b>经验修补</>，<b>冰霜行者</>以及<b>灵魂疾行</>。$(br2)<light_gray><i>注意：保护与摔落缓冲对仓鼠无效，因此不能加在盔甲上。盔甲本身已经为仓鼠提供防御，且仓鼠无视摔落伤害。别太贪。</>
多读书
在箱子里找到了一块<dark_green><b>仓鼠锻造模板</>？太棒了。$(br2)锻造台可以为<dark_green><b>盔甲</>打上你喜欢的花纹。$(br2)每种材料都有各自...<i>独特</>的效果。
军备升级
<light_gray><b>铁：</>降低风阻，提升投掷速度。$(br)<gold><b>金：</>获得永久的速度提升效果。$(br)<dark_purple><b>下界合金：</>将仓鼠转变为坚果。获得击退抗性且大幅提升投掷伤害。
一阶升级效果

book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_1.passa: The Broom is the rideable mount from Hexerei. This allows witches to fly with it and with that the ability to traverse the lands with ease. Currently there are two broom types available which one is Willow and the other Mahogany.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_2.passa: First off the Willow broom. This broom is the slower of the brooms, which is nice for server exploration and nice for precise building. Though, it being slower you may have already figured out that it is easier to make for the early game.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_3.passa: Second the Mahogany broom. This broom faster than the Willow Broom, which is great for getting around faster than before. Not only is this broom faster but its item is also fire and lava resistant, but not while the broom is an entity.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_4.passa: To use the broom, right click on the ground with the broom, just like a boat. Then to ride it simply right click, and to open its GUI crouch and right click. While riding, to ascend up into the clouds hold Space and to descend back to the ground hold %kkey.hexerei.broomDescend and be sure to check the keybinds if there are conflicting keys, or change the descend key to your desired key.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_5.passa:
The rest of the broom controls act like a boat. Now that you know how to fly the broom lets get into its GUI and attachments.

 Again to access the broom simply crouch and right click the broom while it is an entity.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_6.passa: To begin there are three slots on the top of the GUI, first the Misc which is for misc attachments on the broom and usually attached to the tip. For example the Broom Chain can be attached to the broom in that slot and when the chain has an item imprinted it will display the item hanging on the chain.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_7.passa: The second slot is for the Satchel and this slot is for the satchel items, there are three tiers of attachments each tier gives an additional 9 slots to hold items within while on your travels.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_8.passa:
The last slot is for the Brush of the broom, this is the brooms power source to be able to fly. The brushes of the broom will deplete while flying around on the broom until the brushes break.
 Once the brush breaks the broom will fall to the ground, so be sure to swap out new brushes on a long journey.
book.hexerei.entities_broom_page_9.passa:
Attachments: 
   Misc: 
   Satchel: 
   Brush: 
 To attach, place each item into their respective slots of the broom's inventory.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_1.passag: The Crow is the first familiar of many to come to Hexerei. They can be tamed by giving the crows their favorite snackies which is the seed mixture made in the pestle and mortar. You can either throw the seeds onto the ground and nearby
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_10.passa: The second help mode is Harvesting and this will allow your crows to harvest any crop and some bush plants nearby the position of the crow, or nearby the position of the crow's perch. The crow will leave the items on the ground, so having another crow
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_11.passa:
that is set to gather all of those items would be quite useful! The crows will be able to harvest any of the Hexerei flowers as well.

  The last of the help modes is Pickpocketing, yes pickpocketing. Crows are able to pickpocket villagers to snag their potential trades. This has a set list for each type of villager, and can give
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_12.passa: common items like emeralds, paper, seeds, and more. Villagers do not need to be leveled up and the loot table is just based off of which job the villager has selected. Each crow has a cooldown before they can pickpocket again. For an example Librarians can give things like books and already enchanted books, which is a great source of early
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_13.passa:
enchanted books. Another example is if you are low on food the crow can go steal from some farmers or butchers to gather some easy food. 

 If you are still trying to figure out how to add a perching location to a crow you need to use the Crow Flute to direct the crow. This is the tool for directing the crows more precisely and can direct more than one
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_14.passa: crow at a time, either all of the nearby crows or the list of selected crows. The flute will tell crows which command to follow. To change the flutes given command you need to open the GUI by crouching and right clicking. When
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_15.passa:
opened you can see that it is very similar to the crows GUI except there are a few extra buttons on the bottom. For example if you set the flute to Sit and then exit the GUI and right click with the flute which will then tell all tamed crows near the player to sit.

  Now to talk about the Select and Perch.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_16.passa: The Select button, when toggled, will change how right clicking outside of the GUI acts. This is used for commanding up to 9 selected crows, so only those crows will listen to that flutes command. When selecting crows simply right click with the flute on the crow you want selected. Once selected the crow will show a selection cube above their head based off
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_17.passa: their dye color. When one or more crows are selected, inside the GUI will show each crow selected at the bottom. To deselect crows simply right click the crow again with the select mode active. To clear all of the selected crows press the small X located next to the select button.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_18.passa: Now that you know all about the select button lets talk about the Perch button. This button requires crows to be selected to work. When crows are selected and the perch button is toggled, exit the GUI and right click on a location, this location will be saved as all of the selected crow's perch. While the button is still toggled
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_19.passa:
you can see all of the selected crow's perch locations with big colored cubes based off of their dye color. These can be removed by clicking on that same red X next to the perch button.

  Now that you know how to control your crow its time to outfit them with names, dyes, and hats! Right click your crow with a dye to add a colored bandanna and they can be renamed similar to
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_2.passag: untamed crows will fly over and munch on them for a chance to tame, or they can just be right clicked onto the crow. Crows have a better chance of taming when the seeds are thrown onto the ground. Players are able to tame more than one crow at a time, allowing for a crow army to work with the player!
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_20.passa: the other dyeable items, like jeb_ or les_ to color change the bandanna.
With all of that said don't forget the crow's favorite snackies!
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_3.passag: Once tamed crows can be set to different commands. The player can change these commands by simply right clicking the crow, this will cycle through the 4 main commands the crows have. These commands can also be changed by opening up the crow's GUI. To open the GUI crouch and right click a tamed crow.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_4.passag: Each crow contains 3 slots, the first being what the crow is holding, the second being the hat the crow is wearing, and the third is a misc slot still to be determined but can act as a storage slot. The crows can be equip with weapons to help fight with you.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_5.passag: Below the item slots of the crow GUI is the commands for the crow. This is where you can set the commands and set the specific help command. The first command on the left is the Follow command, this will make the crow follow closely behind the player or hop onto the players shoulder.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_6.passag:
The second command is the Sit command, this will make the crow land and try to sit. If the crow has a perch position it will instead fly over to that perch and sit.

  The third command is the Wander command, this will make the crow wander and fly around the area.
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_7.passag:
If the crow has a perch location the crow will not wonder too far away from the perch.

  The last command is the Help command, this command is unique and has three separate modes to it. When the
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_8.passag: Help command is selected the modes on the right will gain color showing that these are in use and using the selected mode. The first of the help modes is Gathering and this will allow your crows to interact with the Coffer or Herb Jar blocks. The crows will interact with nearby
book.hexerei.entities_crow_page_9.passag: coffers or Herb Jars that have the Crow Gather button toggled on. The crows will seek out any items in the area matching items already inside the container, unless the crow has a perch at the container, then it will pickup ANY item in the area and deposit it back in that container.

book.hexerei.intro_page_1.passage_1:
Welcome to the wonderful witchcraft filled world of Hexerei! Where many of your desires, known and unknown, will be met to it's fullest! 

This mod is my life and soul right now, I put in nearly all of my time and energy into it. 

made by: JoeFoxe
book.hexerei.intro_page_2.passage_1:
I have been working on this book for over a month, designing it completely from scratch. I hope it is everything and more for what people were wanting. 

Tons more content is yet to come, but this content will be from coven witches to casting spells to more familiars and much more! Stay tuned!
book.hexerei.intro_page_3.passage_1:
If you have not figured it out already, at the bottom corners of the opened pages should be arrows directing you to the next page or previous page.
  As well as an X which will close the book and lay it down and a Home button which will direct you to the index.
book.hexerei.intro_page_4.passage_1:
On the top left of the page is for bookmark the pages you are on, clicking it again will change the bookmarks color.
  Bookmarks will pop up on the sides and top of the pages, these can be moved around by simply right clicking, holding, and dragging to another slot.
book.hexerei.intro_page_5.passage_1:
They can be swapped with another bookmark or with an empty slot. Clicking on a bookmark will redirect you to the page that it was saved on.
  Crouch and right click the altar to pick up the book. 
  The book can be opened or closed when picked up, if left opened it will still show the pages on the book, though for now you wont be able to turn the pages in hand, it must be on an altar.
book.hexerei.intro_page_6.passage_1:
In the configs you can change the font from fancy to normal minecraft font if its hard to read or you are wanting more immersion.
  You are also able to hover items and press %kkey.hexerei.book_hovering_recipe for recipes and %kkey.hexerei.book_hovering_uses for uses to open up the JEI page respectively
book.hexerei.items_altar_1.passage_2: The Altar will be used for not just reading the book on, but can be used for decoration as you can place any item down on the altar, and a special surprise for anything that can be potted that is placed onto the altar.
book.hexerei.items_animal_fat_1.passage_: Animal Fat is one of the core items needed to make Tallow. Tallow is used to make candles with the Dipper attachment. Can be obtained by killing any Cow, Pig, or Sheep, and is effected by looting.
The berries of the Belladonna Plant are very poisonous. Many may know the other name for the belladonna plant as nightshade. These berries will be used in the future for various mixtures and blends within the pestle and mortar for infusing your candles with various effects.
book.hexerei.items_belladonna_flower_1.p: The most poisonous plant of Hexerei, the Belladonna, probably should not be consumed in any way unless prepared in the proper manor. These plants can be harvested by simply right clicking it when it is fully grown just like a sweet berry bush.
Belladonna flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Belladonna Plant.
book.hexerei.items_blood_bottle_1.passag: To acquire the blood you first need a Mixing Cauldron with a Blood Sigil inside, then simply jump in the cauldron 3 times to drain enough blood for one bottle to scoop it out. To scoop it out simply right click the cauldron with an empty bottle.
book.hexerei.items_blood_sigil_1.passage: The Blood Sigil is an attachment for the Mixing Cauldron and what is needed to acquire a Bottle of Blood to make your brooms. This will also be used in other sorts of recipes in the future. As well as other types of sigils to be added for different methods in the cauldron.
book.hexerei.items_book_of_shadows_1.pas:
Yes the book is talking about itself, but you are going need this in the witching world.

 The cover of the book is dyed with the dye used in crafting. The corners of the book can also be dyed after crafting by placing it back into the grid with another dye.
book.hexerei.items_broom_brush_1.passage: The Broom Brush is the last attachment type for the broom. This is what fuels the broom to be able to fly, and while flying the brush takes durability damage. Once the brush runs out of durability it does break, so be sure you have extras when flying long distances.
book.hexerei.items_broom_keychain_1.pass: The cutest broom attachment as it makes a keychain trinket of the item imprinted onto it. To imprint an item onto the chain simply add both items into a crafting grid. To use open up a broom's menu and place inside the Misc slot.
book.hexerei.items_broom_keychain_3.pass:
The item is no longer consumed fully and you can retrieve it by placing the Broom Chain back into a crafting grid and it will pull the item out of it.
  The chain will even swing around as the broom moves around to add extra aesthetics!
book.hexerei.items_broom_netherite_tip_1: This broom attachment is very useful for nether flight, as it allows the broom to fly completely through lava or any fires without getting damaged. Just like the rest of the misc attachments, this goes in the leftmost slot of the broom.
book.hexerei.items_broom_waterproof_tip_: Have a base underwater but tired of falling off your broom and not being able to use it? Try the waterproof tip! This allows the player to stay on the broom while riding underwater. Just like the rest of the misc attachments, this goes in the leftmost slot of the broom.
book.hexerei.items_candelabra_1.passage_: Candelabras are a great decoration item as you can place them under a block or above a block to give them a different look. Works great with chains above!
book.hexerei.items_candle_1.passage_2: Candles are great decoration options as you can mix and match different candles in the same block up to 4 candles. Each candle has a lit time of 35 minutes, this may vary as infused candles come out along with different kinds of candles.
book.hexerei.items_candle_3.passage_1: You are able to light each separate candle from first placed to last placed, this may changed to where you use the flint and steel to light the candle you are looking at. Candles are able to float around an Altar as well as later will float around the player for rituals and spells.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_1.passage_2: The Coffer is a very useful storage device for witches, especially ones who have some crow friends.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_2.passage_1: To craft you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_3.passage_1: Coffers can also be dyed with any color and be renamed to change their colors in a loop.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_3.passage_2: Once dyed, if not named, they can be dyed again to mix the dye colors like leather armor.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_4.passage_1:
For ease of use coffers can be picked up with a simple punch. They will retain all of their data when moved by the player. They also will display their items while opened.

  On the right side of the GUI of the coffer will show a button with a crow on it.
book.hexerei.items_coffer_5.passage_1:
While toggled the crow button will allow crows on gather mode to check items inside its coffers and look in the area for items matching the any of the contents of the coffer to deposit. 

  Crows also with a perch located on a coffer will pick up any item in the area and return it to that coffer.
book.hexerei.items_crow_flute_1.passage_: The Crow Flute is an essential item for controlling your crow companions! .
book.hexerei.items_crystal_ball_1.passag: The Crystal Ball is still a work in progress, right now it acts as just a decoration item. This will probably be used for either scrying to find players or positions, or for infusing certain items.
book.hexerei.items_dipper_1.passage_2: The Dipper is an addon for the Mixing Cauldron for its main function of making candles by dipping string into the tallow below. Simply place on top of a Mixing Cauldron by crouching and right clicking the top of the cauldron with the Dipper.
book.hexerei.items_dipper_3.passage_1: The Dipper has 3 separate slots each of which can hold a single item. If the fluid below matches a recipe for one of the items on the dipper it will begin dipping it in the fluid til the recipe completes to transform the item. This meaning the Dipper can not only make candles in tallow but be able to make any item
book.hexerei.items_dipper_4.passage_1: in any fluid as long as it matches a recipe. For example, you can color candles with blood by putting them on a dipper with enough blood below.
book.hexerei.items_dowsing_rod_1.passage: The Dowsing Rod is one of the first items a witch should look for as it points them in the right direction of where they need to go. Crouch and right clicking will swap the mode between Swamp to Jungle. Right clicking will find a new position in the closest biome of the selected type.
book.hexerei.items_dried_belladonna_flow: The dried variant of the belladonna flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_mandrake_flower: The dried variant of the mandrake flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_mugwort_flowers: The dried variant of the mugwort flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_mugwort_leaves_: The dried variant of the mugwort leaves, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_sage_bundle_1.p: This bundle is now useful in the Sage Burning Plate. To use simply right click your bundle onto the plate, once the bundle is on the plate it can be lit with flint and steel. This is the fuel to cleansing the area of spawning mobs within it.
book.hexerei.items_dried_yellow_dock_flo: The dried variant of the yellow dock flowers, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_dried_yellow_dock_lea: The dried variant of the yellow dock leaves, this does not have any uses yet but will be used in various blends and in rituals in the future.
book.hexerei.items_drying_rack_1.passage: These are used for drying items that have a recipe to be dried. They are quite useful for obtaining early game leather by drying rotten flesh into leather. To place items into a drying rack simply right click with the item stack in hand.
book.hexerei.items_drying_rack_3.passage:
There are 3 separate slots in the drying rack, each slot can hold up to 3 of that item. Each time you right click it with an item in hand, it will take up to 3 of those items and place it into the drying rack.
  To remove all items from the drying rack that arent crafting, both hands must be bare and you crouch and right click the drying rack.
book.hexerei.items_drying_rack_4.passage:
You can also simply right click to remove items that have completed their drying process, no crouching necessary.
  Automation can be done using item transportation blocks, like hoppers or item pipes.
A really nice decoration item to decorate your own ponds or rivers with.
book.hexerei.items_gold_rings_1.passage_: The first broom attachment made, there will probably be some sort of effects to these little trinkets later but for now it is just a cosmetic addition to the broom. To use open up a broom's menu and place inside the Misc slot.
book.hexerei.items_herb_enhanced_broom_b: Just like the normal Broom Brush other than it has more durability so it lasts longer in flight. These can be enchanted with Mending and Unbreaking.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_1.passage_2:
The Herb Jar is the drawer for witches. This device can hold up to 1024 items of only one item.
  Crows also will find and place matching items into jars just like they do coffers if you have the button toggled within its GUI.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_2.passage_1:
To access the jar GUI simply right click on any of the faces except the front, to access from the front right click and crouch with a bare hand.
 Take items out of the jars by punching the face or take a full stack by crouch punching the face.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_3.passage_1: To craft you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_4.passage_1: Herb Jars can also be dyed with any color and be renamed to change their colors in a loop.
book.hexerei.items_herb_jar_4.passage_2: Once dyed, if not named, they can be dyed again to mix the dye colors like leather armor.
book.hexerei.items_index_page_1.passage_: This chapter will be all about items and how you obtain them and what you do with them. If you click on another item on a page and if it has a page attached to that item the book will quickly turn it's pages there!
book.hexerei.items_infused_fabric_1.pass: Infused Fabric is the fabric used to craft the base witch outfit. It will have more uses than just armor but as of right now its just armor.
book.hexerei.items_large_satchel_1.passa: The Large Satchel is the highest tier of satchels. The largest of the satchels adds an additional 27 slots that can be used to store items. To add and access simply open your brooms menu and place the satchel into the middle slot of the broom.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_broom_1.pass: The faster of the two brooms. The mahogany broom as an item also has fire resistance so it cannot be lost in lava or burn to fire. Although, it can break when flying the broom into fire, unless the broom has a netherite tip attachment.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_log_1.passag: Mahogany Logs are used in the making of a mahogany broom within the mixing cauldron. Also a very good decoration block with its very rich mahogany color.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_planks_1.pas: Mahogany Planks and its variants are great decoration pieces to give a nice warm wood to use in cosy builds.
book.hexerei.items_mahogany_sapling_1.pa: Sapling used to grow Mahogany trees. Can be obtained by breaking Mahogany Leaves.
book.hexerei.items_mandrake_flower_1.pas: One of the flowers of Hexerei, the Mandrake, can be harvested by simply right clicking it when it is fully grown just like a sweet berry bush. Can be harvested when fully grown by right clicking just like a sweet berry bush.
book.hexerei.items_mandrake_flowers_1.pa:
Mandrake flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mandrake Plant.
book.hexerei.items_mandrake_root_1.passa:
The root of the Mandrake Plant, used as an essential part for building the broom brushes as well as crafting the broom itself. It will have future uses of turning it into oils or using the root in certain recipes.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mandrake Plant.
book.hexerei.items_medium_satchel_1.pass: The Medium Satchel is the second tier of satchels. This satchel adds an additional 18 slots that can be used to store items. To add and access simply open your brooms menu and place the satchel into the middle slot of the broom.
book.hexerei.items_mindful_trance_blend_: This is a hint to what is to come for candles. This will be for infusing candles with special effects to give off in the area when they are lit. This will be coming shortly in the future.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_1.pas: The Mixing Cauldron is one of the main tools in the witches arsenal.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_3.pas: You are able to toss items into the cauldron from the top to fill the slots as well as use any item transporting block (ie. hoppers) to pump items in. It also has a GUI that you can access where you can place and take items.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_4.pas:
You can click the center to access the JEI recipes. While scrolling through JEI you can now click the transfer button to transfer over your items for easy crafting.

  The slot on the left is for Sigils, right now its only one which is the Blood Sigil.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_5.pas:
The cauldron can hold any kind of fluid up to two buckets. Fluid can be pumped in with other mods pipes. You can also use bottles on the base liquids and ones from this mod in the cauldron. 
  Although it seems like it would burn items when in lava but in fact they do stay safe.
book.hexerei.items_mixing_cauldron_6.pas: All of these fluids are used in some way in the cauldron. Along with the fluid being used in crafting inside the cauldron it can also be used by the Dipper item which is placed on top of the cauldron.
book.hexerei.items_mugwort_bush_1.passag: A bush flower of Hexerei, the Mugwort, has been used to open up a more direct channel to the lunar side of magic. This has no uses for magic yet, these will come at a later date. Can be harvested when fully grown by right clicking.
book.hexerei.items_mugwort_flowers_1.pas:
Mugwort flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mugwort Bush.
book.hexerei.items_mugwort_leaves_1.pass:
Mugwort Leaves are used in the recipe to make the normal broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Mugwort Bush.
This hat is being a little hint towards what types off witches and covens are to come in future updates.
book.hexerei.items_pestle_and_mortar_1.p: The Pestle and Mortar is used for smashing, smooshing, grinding, and turning things into a fine paste. This will be used for making the blends and pastes for infusing your candles to give them effects while lit. It is also used to create the crows favorite snackies!
book.hexerei.items_pestle_and_mortar_3.p: To add items to the mortar simply right click with the item in hand, it will only add one item at a time. Crouch and right click the mortar to pull out all items within as long as they are not already crafting. You can also simply right click to remove items that have completed their crafting process.
book.hexerei.items_reading_glasses_1.pas: Need help reading the book? want to just slightly zoom into the book to better look at images? Well these are the glasses for you! Acts like a spyglass when holding the item and right clicking, but zooms in just a bit. You can also put these on your head and press %kkey.hexerei.glasses_zoom to toggle zoom in.
book.hexerei.items_sage_1.passage_2: The Sage Leaf is obtained by farming the sage crop. Sage is a very useful herb in witchery as it is used to cleanse the area of evil spirits. This sage can be burned if bundled up and then dried.
book.hexerei.items_sage_bundle_1.passage: This bundle is not quite useful yet, first needs to be dried before use in the Sage Burning Plate.
The Sage Burning Plate is for protection around the witches setup. Simply place one down fill it with a bundle of dried sage and light it to protect your area.
  The default area of the spawn protection is a radius of 48. Though monsters will still wander in the radius.
To craft you need a Mixing Cauldron and the items shown below.
Sage smoke will appear randomly in the area when a bundle is lit. The smoke particles can be changed or turned off by right clicking the plate with a bare hand.
  The smoke has 4 different modes it can be set to. The ring of smoke shows the range it will reach and the others are for aesthetic.
book.hexerei.items_sage_seed_1.passage_2: These seeds are found by breaking grass. These are the seeds needed to grow the sage crop.
book.hexerei.items_seed_mixture_1.passag: Looking for a way to tame the crows? Well, Crows love this mixture of seeds. These crows are quite useful so it does take a bit to get one on your side. Be sure to make a fair amount of seed mixture to tame your crows.
book.hexerei.items_small_satchel_1.passa: The Small Satchel is the first satchel for your brooms. This adds an additional 9 slots that can be used to store items. To add and access simply open your brooms menu and place the satchel into the middle slot of the broom.
book.hexerei.items_warhammer_1.passage_2: Wait a minute, this isn't a witchy item. Looks like this is more for someone like the god of thunder. Maybe a crow will like to use this item. If not its quite good for bashing things in the face.
book.hexerei.items_wet_broom_brush_1.pas: To make a broom brush you must first craft the wet one within a cauldron, then throw this on a drying rack to get your broom brush ready for your broom.
book.hexerei.items_wet_herb_enhanced_bro: Just like the normal Wet Broom Brush this is made in a cauldron and must be dried before using.
book.hexerei.items_willow_broom_1.passag: A witches main tool of transportation, the broom. So far there are two types of brooms, this one being the lesser of the two. These can be upgraded in 3 different slots, Misc, Satchel, and Brush. A brush is what powers the brooms flight and comes with every fresh broom made.
book.hexerei.items_willow_broom_3.passag: To access the brooms inventory simply crouch and right click while the broom is in the world. While flying the broom, the brush gets damaged and can break. So, the witch must come prepared and craft some additional brushes to fuel the broom.
book.hexerei.items_willow_broom_4.passag: The best way is to stash the extra brushes within the broom's satchel. Adding a small satchel will add 9 extra spaces to hold items within, and each tier above will hold an additional 9 spaces.
book.hexerei.items_willow_log_1.passage_: Willow logs are used in making a willow broom within the mixing cauldron. They are also a lovely decoration block for a more gloomy or nature-like builds.
book.hexerei.items_willow_planks_1.passa: Willow planks and its variants are great decoration pieces as they bring in a nice green wood for more nature-like builds.
book.hexerei.items_willow_sapling_1.pass: Sapling used to grow Willow trees. Can be obtained by breaking Willow Leaves.
book.hexerei.items_witch_boots_1.passage: These pieces will have additional effects once spells and the coven witches are added. Each piece of the witch outfit can be dyed to be customized to your liking. They can also be renamed to give the color changing effects.
book.hexerei.items_witch_chestplate_1.pa: These pieces will have additional effects once spells and the coven witches are added. Each piece of the witch outfit can be dyed to be customized to your liking. They can also be renamed to give the color changing effects.
book.hexerei.items_witch_helmet_1.passag: These pieces will have additional effects once spells and the coven witches are added. Each piece of the witch outfit can be dyed to be customized to your liking. They can also be renamed to give the color changing effects.
book.hexerei.items_yellow_dock_bush_1.pa: The last bush flower of Hexerei, the Yellow Dock, has been used to break binding ties that prevent those from moving on. This will be used in sorts of magic for the spirit coven, which will be coming in future updates. Can be harvested when fully grown by right clicking.
book.hexerei.items_yellow_dock_flowers_1:
Yellow Dock flowers are used in the recipe to make the herb enhanced broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Yellow Dock Bush.
Yellow Dock Leaves are used in the recipe to make the normal broom brush, they can also be dried and later on will be used in different infuses and rituals.
  Obtained by right clicking a fully grown Yellow Dock Bush.
book.hexerei.structures_dark_coven_page_: As well as witch huts you can also find Dark Covens within swamps. These are the home of witches, and in future updates they will be replaced with custom coven witches which will have their own special fitting in Hexerei.
Until then, you can find various crafting tools, armor, and herbs within the covens.
book.hexerei.structures_index_page_1.pas: This chapter will be all about the structures added to the world and how you can find them!
book.hexerei.structures_witch_hut_page_1: Throughout the swamp you may come across different variations of a Hexerei witch hut. These huts come along with witches and all of their tools, and will later have more uses in future updates!
book.hexerei.structures_witch_hut_page_2: A great place to start off a base for an aspiring witch!
